## Vertical slice (acceptance gate)

```bash
cd runtime
PYTHONPATH=src python -m pytest tests -q
```

Proves:

1. Hello Pico domain behaviour
2. Native + Durable pass the same contract
3. `event_count` survives restart (`test_persistence.py`)
4. Multiple identities stay isolated across restart
